sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach's underlying form remains strong with seven wins in their last ten outings. They face an Alsager side in poor form at the foot of the division with just one win all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday seeking to keep pace with Sandbach, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two in-form sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, level on points with AFC Bridgnorth in fourth, visit Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to face Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Barnton host Shawbury United in a fixture between sides at opposite ends of form, with Shawbury on an alarming six-game losing streak. Market Drayton Town visit New Mills as both teams battle in mid-table, while Crewe host Allscott Heath in a match between struggling sides. Brereton Social, winless in their last three, begin with a home fixture against Widnes Town before a midweek clash against Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's weakest performers.
